However, on the requests received from the stakeholders, the Authority decided to extend the last date for submission of written comments thrice. The final last date for submission of comments and counter comments were 14th December 2023 and 28th December 2023 respectively. 3.4 In response to the consultation paper, the Authority received comments from fifteen stakeholders {Service providers - 07, Industry Association- 05, Consumer Advisory Group (CAG)- 01 and other organizations- 02} and counter comments from two stakeholders (Service provider - 01, Industry Association- 01).
